headline: Federal Regulatory Gazette — Official Confirmation Notice

entries.headline: Official confirmation: Company X sanctioned
entries.body: The regulatory authority officially confirms that Company X was sanctioned on 14 August 2026 following the conclusion of its regulatory review. The listing covers the Company X group including its holding entity.
